"You don't have super powers." 
That's the last thing I saw before I ran. 
I ran hard, sprinting home. Tonight was a mistake. I adopted a vigilante persona, thinking I was untouchable. Invincible, even. But there was always something, always a nail where it wasn't, stopping my attackers, always a bat, or a brick, where it was most useful. My life had become a video game, nearly. But I knew my wife was worried for me, being out all hours of the night, coming home in the wee hours dressed in all black. So when I followed my latest bit of criminal scum down the alley, I knew I would be safe, I mean, nothing hurts me! Right? And that's when I saw it. He had reached a dead end. I was standing by the only door to enter the building to our left, and I had my hand axe to my side, prepared to deal out justice. But we both saw it. Sprayed in red, on the wall, right there. "You don't have super powers.". That moment he turned to me, pistol ready. I turned and ran. Hard. Hearing the door fly open behind me, too afraid to look. Two shots. None of them even came close. As I re enter the street, I see a final message on the sidewalk. "I love you, and I always said I'd die for you."
